Nikos Karakanis (NK Electrics) is an electrician based in Evangelistraki, Mykonos. He takes on electrical installations, upgrades, studies, Υ.Δ.Ε. certificates and fault repairs in homes, villas and business premises all over the island — with a 24-hour fault service.

Services

Electrical services in Mykonos

With an emphasis on safety, proper planning and quality workmanship, we take on electrical installations and upgrades of every size.

  • Quality electrical installations designed around your space and current safety standards. From choosing the materials to the final handover, every stage aims at a durable, safe network — for homes, villas and business premises, new builds and renovations.

  • A complete Installer’s Declaration (Υ.Δ.Ε.) for new and existing installations. A detailed inspection against current regulations, so the network runs safely and the property has a legal electricity supply — with every document and diagram ready to submit to the grid operator (ΔΕΔΔΗΕ).

  • Repairs from minor malfunctions to more complex problems. Modern equipment for targeted diagnosis and a repair that lasts, so your space works normally again — quickly and safely.

  • Studies made for your project: installation design, load calculations, choice of materials and compliance with regulations — aiming at safety, energy efficiency and room to expand later, for homes and business premises.

  • A power cut, a short circuit or a sudden malfunction? Fault service is available around the clock, every day, for a fast and safe repair — whatever the hour.

Certificates

What a Υ.Δ.Ε. is — and when you need it

The Installer’s Declaration (Υ.Δ.Ε.) certifies that an electrical installation is safe and meets the regulations. It comes with the documents and diagrams the grid operator (ΔΕΔΔΗΕ) asks for.

A new electricity supply
Reconnection or a change of supply
An increase in power
After a renovation or an extension

Not sure what applies to your property? Call us and we will tell you before we start.

Are you available for faults at night and at weekends?

Yes. Fault service is available 24 hours a day, every day. Call 698 653 5596.

Which areas of Mykonos do you cover?

The whole of Mykonos. We are based in Evangelistraki.

Do you issue the installer’s declaration (Υ.Δ.Ε.)?

Yes. We inspect the installation against the regulations and prepare the declaration with every document and diagram needed for the grid operator.

Do you work on villas and business premises?

Yes. We take on homes, villas and business premises, from new installations to upgrades and renovations.

How do I get a quote for an installation?

Call 698 653 5596 or email nkelectricsmykonos@gmail.com with a few words about the space and what you need — photos help. We reply with the next steps.

Do you make a study before the installation?

Yes. The study covers the design, the load calculations and the choice of materials, so the installation is safe and can be extended later.
